_comment: Delta patch for knowledge/graph/agentic_universe_graph.json. Generic node/edge shape — adapt to agentic_universe_schema.json and validate with tools/knowledge_graph.py before applying. Dedupe protocol/benchmark/deprecation nodes if earlier patches already added them.

nodes.label: A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol
nodes.summary: Open standard for agent‑to‑agent communication: signed Agent Cards, multi‑tenancy, gRPC; joined Agentic AI Foundation (Aug 2026). Horizontal layer for task negotiation/delegation across org boundaries.

nodes.label: MCP (Model Context Protocol) 2026-07-28
nodes.summary: Vertical layer for agent→tools/data access; 2026-07-28 spec made core stateless (no initialize handshake, no session ID); cacheable lists, MRTR, header-based routing, hardened OAuth/OIDC.

nodes.label: Long-Horizon Terminal-Bench (LHTB)
nodes.summary: 46 tasks, hundreds of episodes, 90-minute budgets; 64.6% partial progress, 4.3% cross 0.95 reward; mean 9.9M tokens, 85.3 minutes/task. Exposes completion cliff for frontier agents.

nodes.label: OpenAI Assistants API sunset (2026-08-26)
nodes.summary: Hard shutdown; replacement is Responses + Conversations APIs; no automated thread migration.

nodes.label: OpenAI Agent Builder + Evals + v1/prompts shutdown (2026-11-30)
nodes.summary: Announced Jun 3, 2026; Evals read-only Oct 31, 2026; full shutdown Nov 30, 2026. Migrate to Agents SDK / Responses API.

nodes.label: Progressive skill/tool disclosure
nodes.summary: Three-layer loading (L1 metadata ~100 tokens, L2 instructions ≤5k tokens, L3 resources on demand); inject 3–5 skills/tools per step; log injected schemas; measure retrieval precision as catalogs grow. Mitigates SkillBloat token-amplification attacks.

nodes.label: Parallel swarm + reconciliation
nodes.summary: Internal task decomposition across 20–300 parallel sub-agents; reconcile outputs; track amplification ratio (system horizon / agent horizon); expect model-native swarm primitives from more vendors.

nodes.label: Fleet gateway registry
nodes.summary: Persistent registry of local/cloud/SSH/remote gateways with health checks; unify bot/chat rosters across gateways; durable agent-to-agent messaging (Hermes hermes peer).

summary.label: Kimi K2.6 (Moonshot AI)
summary.summary: Open-weight 1T MoE (32B active/token); Agent Swarm scales to 300 parallel sub-agents, 4,000 coordinated steps/run; ~4.5×·faster than single-agent sequential; PARL trains only the orchestrator.
